interpretation: C jointly changes group-aware staging-loader and 64x64 dispatch geometry while preserving per-group coefficients, MMA arithmetic and original split counts.
A barrier-only grouping did not improve throughput; E 128-wide staging reduced throughput despite exact outputs. Barrier count alone does not identify the bottleneck.
C six-round paired median speedups at 512/1024 were 1.15676555491474 and 1.1489792909696237; the independent four-round confirmation was 1.1508890426445197 and 1.1469327863168204.
Short 32/128-token results were noisy; individual loader/tile contributions and hardware bottlenecks were not isolated using GPU counters.
Metal allocation and process RSS share unified-memory pages and are not additive. Original and C peak tracked Metal allocations were both 904593408 bytes in these context2048 runs.
Native scoring prefill timing excludes state creation, readout and private JSON/pipe overhead. Power, temperature and filesystem cache were uncontrolled.
This evidence adds scoped results separately and preserves the original GGUF import report and qualification boundaries.
